# An @mount that awaits is emitted inside functions marked async, all the way
# up the settle chain.
#
# The handler body is lifted into __effectN_mount, which __effectN_up calls,
# which the group settle calls. The checker coloured the program before any of
# those existed, so every one of them was emitted as a plain `function` while
# the call sites still wrote `await` off the callee's colour. esbuild is what
# noticed: this is a generate test rather than a golden because the assertion
# is that the bundle parses, and only the real bundler can say so.

sngl generate --out out app.sngl
exists out/index.html
grep 'async function __effect0_mount' out/index.html
grep 'async function __effect0_up' out/index.html
grep 'async function __effects0_settle' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import api "js:./api"

output { none { html } }

component main {
    var url = "a"
    var greeting = ""
    effect(on=url, @mount(k) {
        greeting = api.fetchHello(k)
    })
    text(value=greeting)
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(name: string): Promise<string> { return "hi " + name; }
